t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I will click s or k to select the knome that i want to help me find mushrooms. Then I will click space to pick up the mushrooms. I may get mushrooms and I may not. I will get extra points for the mushrooms I find. Sometimes I get extra 5 points for each round.

vb_textbox.text: I think the key to this game test is to go as fast as possible to avoid being too slow. However, don't stick to one key, as this increases your chances to move.
